lines.text: Read me back what I wrote from your words. A dark like a night sky, underground. Light that runs along lines, like water in channels. Ground that pushes you.
That's the bottom of the world, as near as I can tell.

It isn't like anywhere. It isn't even like the floor above it, and every other floor resembles its neighbours. I've stopped trying to fit it to anything I know, and I don't say that easily. Go carefully down there. Write everything.
